data.title: Reliance Global Moves to Acquire Majority Stake in China Automotive Interiors Group
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Reliance Global Holdings Limited ( (HK:0723) ).

Reliance Global Holdings Limited has disclosed that its subsidiary Trans Minerals has entered into a memorandum of understanding to potentially acquire a 51% equity stake in a China-based automotive interior decoration group, which develops, manufactures and sells products such as composite floors. Upon completion, the target group would become indirect non-wholly-owned subsidiaries of Reliance Global, with their financial results consolidated into the company’s accounts.

Under the MOU, Trans Minerals will conduct due diligence on the target group and has agreed to pay a refundable deposit of RMB10,000,000 to the vendor within five business days, which may be applied toward the purchase price if a formal acquisition agreement is signed. The consideration for the deal will be determined through negotiation, referencing asset valuation, financial position and future prospects, signaling Reliance Global’s strategic move to deepen its presence in the automotive interiors market while limiting risk through a refundable deposit structure.

data.title: Bitfire Group Overhauls Share Option Framework After EGM Approvals
data.description:
New Huo Technology Holdings Limited ( (HK:1611) ) has issued an announcement.

Bitfire Group Holdings Limited announced that shareholders have approved all resolutions put forward at an extraordinary general meeting held in Hong Kong on 15 September 2026. Directors attended both in person and electronically, and Tricor Investor Services Limited acted as scrutineer for the poll to validate the voting process.

Investors endorsed the adoption of a new share option scheme and related mandate limits, as well as a specific sublimit for service providers, with strong majorities exceeding 97 percent of votes cast. The meeting also approved the termination of the company’s existing share option scheme adopted in 2016, signaling an overhaul of its employee and partner incentive framework that may influence future alignment of management and stakeholder interests.
